title: The Importance of Tarbiyah al-Diniyyah for Children
reference_info: حقوق الأولاد على الوالدين - عماد عبدالعظيم (الألوكة)

text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of raising children upon the love of Allah and His Messenger ﷺ, and mentions Prophetic hadiths that urge teaching children Salah and acts of worship from a young age. It also highlights the role of parents in instilling religious values and akhlaq in the hearts of their children. It emphasizes that sound tarbiyah positively reflects on the child's behavior in the future.

review_defects.why: The Arabic adjective 'الأخلاقية' modifies 'القيم' (values), meaning 'religious and moral values' as a single concept. The English renders it as two separate nouns, 'religious values' and 'akhlaq', changing the meaning.
